reviews.text: Excellent care for our pets; they are very attentive and explain everything very well. I highly recommend Dr. Carolina; she is very professional and caring. Highly recommended.
They treated my dog ​​very well, very professional
A good veterinary hospital, one of the most complete in the city, with an excellent reception.

The service was excellent, very respectful, and they were honest and responsible at all times.
They took very good care of my kitten.

On Wednesday, October 7th of this year, I went to the vet for a medical emergency involving my cat. It's important to note that I went at night. The service I received was terrible. I was told I would have to wait two and a half to three hours to be seen, even though there was only one other patient in the waiting room. Do they no longer have enough staff? Similarly, the person who greeted me at reception provided terrible customer service and lacked any tact. I should clarify that this was my go-to vet for any emergency involving my pets. I hope the staff sees this comment and improves their nighttime service.
They kill your pets and refuse to give you information or tell you what medications they prescribe when you ask.
Inexperienced hospital, bad attitude, and they ask you to pay for NECESSARY information about your pet.
Excellent service and prices, they are the best for taking care of your pets. We have gone twice for emergencies and the treatment towards them and towards us has always been the best.

Professional.
Friendly.
They love dogs and treat them with the utmost respect.
Clear, itemized bills based on a price list; no hidden charges.
Payment accepted in cash and by card.
We went to the neurologist, and the doctors are experts.
They served us incredibly quickly and were always very honest about my girlfriend's pet. It's not only excellent service, but also very humane. Thank you so much.
Excellent care, the veterinarians received our dog promptly and gave her attention, thank you

Terrible service. They don't respect visiting hours and make you wait at least 45 minutes. They don't know who's in charge of your pet and don't provide any information or a diagnosis after several days. Communication with the attending veterinarian is practically nonexistent, and they prevent or deny you contact with specialists. Find another veterinary hospital for your pets.

Dr. Victor Alcántara was rude, arrogant, and obnoxious during his 10 PM emergency appointment on a weekday. He provokes his patients. We've never been treated like this before. The service was terrible. I hope you take these comments into account to help him change his attitude and approach.
My pug had an emergency, he lost his eye 😭 and the vet was very attentive and kind. I loved the way she treated me. Thank you 🙏🏻

We've been going there for our dog's treatment for a long time, and it's been great. They're always busy, so the wait is long, but it's worth it because they're so good. Our baby recently passed away, and the staff was incredibly kind and compassionate. It's perfectly normal for them to charge fees, but they handle everything very tactfully. I definitely recommend them for your furry friends.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS HERE
On Saturday, September 5th, I took my dog ​​in for an emergency because she was walking like she was drunk and stumbling sideways. First of all, there was no neurologist on staff, and although Dr. Araceli saw her, we were there for a good two hours. She examined her along with an internist, and all they kept saying was "probable stroke." They made her walk, took videos, did an ultrasound, and ordered blood tests (which they still haven't sent me as of September 9th). The doctor told me she was "improving" during the time she saw me, even though I said NO, that she looked worse than when we arrived. She insisted she was "improving," all to end up telling me to go back the next day to the neurologist. I spent over 3,000 pesos, and they weren't even sure what was wrong with her. When we got home, she couldn't walk anymore, she couldn't even stand up; her legs felt lifeless (they didn't even weigh anything). I called them, and their only The solution was to hospitalize her so a neurologist could examine her the very next day. That same afternoon/evening, I decided to take her to another hospital, and when they examined her, they told me it was a thrombosis. The doctor who saw her there even said that the staff at this veterinary clinic SHOULD HAVE KNOWN, given all the symptoms, that a neurologist wasn't necessary. He even told me that, in fact, they didn't know. Unfortunately, my puppy had no hope left, and we had to put her down that day.

Therefore, I recommend that you DO NOT COME HERE, especially not to such incompetent doctors. You believe them because you're not a doctor, but they studied it and didn't even know what was wrong with her. No one will bring my puppy back.
Very good place, they attend to you quickly for any emergency and are very empathetic.
Excellent service, they could improve the facilities, the waiting area, good technology and attention.
There's an emergency clinic; the doctor was very kind and careful when examining my dog.

Although my kitten sadly couldn't be saved because the damage was advanced, severe, undetectable, and irreversible, this was the only place where I could get a concrete diagnosis of what was wrong with my little one. While I'm filled with terrible sadness today, I'm at peace knowing that everything humanly and medically possible was done to save her. The neurology and cardiology teams were always empathetic, and all the information provided was clear. I'm grateful because I know she was treated properly; she passed away without pain, and I know what was wrong with her and what her illness was.
The cost can be expensive (but not exorbitant) for most families, so if it's within your means and your little friend needs it, I would recommend making the investment. The only downside I see is the long wait. The hospital sees a lot of patients, so the doctors are clearly very busy.

I'm writing this review with all my heart, and I hope it helps. Tito and I went to this, our third vet, and I finally feel like I'm in a place that understands my cat's needs. We arrived as an emergency, and although it took some time, the wait was worth it. He was hospitalized, and I always had peace of mind knowing he was being monitored because they provide updates and are very empathetic. From the moment you walk in, at every visit, they talk about how your little one is doing as if he were their own. Lupita, thank you for taking such good care of my boy. Every vet on duty, especially Jair, his vet, I can't thank you enough. Seriously, don't hesitate to come to this vet clinic because my cat is still with me. The prices aren't outrageously high, but they're not exactly cheap either, and it's worth every penny and every minute spent there.

I took my dog ​​to the vet because his blood sugar dropped. He was hospitalized for three days, and one dog died each day (three in total), including mine. He was admitted for low blood sugar, and then they said he had parvovirus, even though my other three dogs who lived with him were perfectly healthy. To top it all off, they charged me for a fourth night even though my dog ​​died at 3:00 AM. We had paid for the night and settled the bill the day before. We thought they would give him to us in a box (at least a shoebox), but instead, they gave him to us wrapped in diapers.

After reviewing previous online reviews, there seems to be a worrying pattern: an insistence on ordering multiple tests, promoting hospitalizations, and creating a considerable administrative burden.

They're just trying to make money off other people's misfortunes.

My dog ​​was hospitalized for four days. It cost $15,000, and they diagnosed him with a herniated disc. He couldn't walk, and when they released him, they only gave me medication. They didn't solve anything; they returned him to me exactly as I left him. My dog ​​hasn't peed or pooped, and they kept saying, "I think he pooped, I'm not sure." They didn't know for sure, and now my dog ​​is very ill. They also gave me the wrong instructions for one of his medications. They told me and wrote down that it should be given every 12 hours when it should be every 24. They are very negligent. Dr. Alejandro is also very arrogant, answers rudely, and squeezed my hand very hard when he said goodbye, which hurt. I'm desperate for my dog, who is still the same or worse, and I'm disappointed in this place. They also told me they would do tests for a possible enlarged liver. They only did blood and urine tests but didn't diagnose why his liver is enlarged. They pricked him and didn't take the opportunity to do thyroid profile studies to see if it was a hormonal issue. I mentioned it to them and they said, "Oh yes, that's right, bring him in so we can do them..." and then pricked him again, and if I didn't tell them, they wouldn't do it.

Terrible service, never go there. The doctors only give you misinformation, are rude and negligent, especially a neurologist named Alejandro. He's incredibly arrogant. When I reported it to Dr. Humberto, the clinic director, he did nothing to resolve the issue. They kept one of my dogs hospitalized for four days for tests and did absolutely nothing. They wrote the wrong prescription, with incorrect medication times, and when you point out their mistake, they just make excuses. They say they care about the pet's well-being, but all they care about is charging you more. I will never go back.

The experience started well but ended up being incredibly unfortunate! After getting the money they wanted, operating on my dog ​​to remove tumors—first pretending they were cancerous, then telling us no, that nothing was necessary anymore—and not sending the tumors for pathology because supposedly it wasn't needed... my dog ​​is still sick. We sought other opinions and were told it was a mistake not to give her chemotherapy. It's important to mention that the doctors who operated on her had studies, x-rays, everything necessary, and yet they still didn't give a proper diagnosis (she was seen by about four veterinarians at this clinic). In short, I don't recommend going here to get your money and then not receive a good diagnosis or lose interest. I say this based on other opinions that indicated the diagnosis wasn't correct and the operation wasn't done properly!
Very professional... Always attentive to everything we needed.
The care has always been very good, in studies, surgeries and physiotherapy.

All the staff are super professional, very patient and dedicated to finding out what's wrong with your dog 🫶
I had to go in at midnight with my dog ​​and they were very attentive and have everything necessary to perform the tests to discover what's wrong with your pet
The physiotherapist was very kind and patient with my dog ​​until he was able to walk again.

We went to the clinic because our dog was having a seizure. The reception staff was rude, but the general practitioner who examined her did a proper job and explained the steps to take to get an appointment with neurologist Humberto Morales, the cost of which was included in the emergency fee. We ran the tests in less than a week so she could be seen as soon as possible. The hospital didn't schedule the appointment; they gave us the neurologist's number, and I kept trying for two weeks to get an appointment, with explanations that the internist was on vacation. I was promised information about the cardiologist, which never arrived. The neurologist asked me to "remind" him to get back to me. In the end, we had to make an appointment at another hospital and lost two valuable weeks for our dog's health. I don't recommend this service because of its negligence, its waste of people's time, and its lack of diligence regarding our dog's health. We don't mind being attentive, but as owners, we're not doctors' assistants to "remind" them to respond; it's part of their job. We don't know if it was because the appointment was "free," but they could have told us if we needed to pay extra and not gamble with our dog's health. She's on long-term treatment to prevent seizures and is waiting for a diagnosis. It was a terrible experience, and I don't recommend the hospital or neurologist Morales.
Don't even bother coming here if you have an emergency at night. The staff has zero empathy; a real disappointment.

Absolutely not recommended for emergencies. Our doctor referred us to take my dog ​​there, but they refused to accept her because she didn't have a referral. If it weren't the IMSS (Mexican Social Security Institute), the service would be terrible, absolutely awful, from those who claim to be guardians of health. And especially because we were taking little angels who couldn't express themselves and couldn't tell us what they felt. Just awful, awful, awful.

Out of respect for myself and my wife, I'm posting this anonymously (I know it's not the first time this has happened). There's a "doctor" named Gabriel who spends his time flirting with female clients, doesn't provide good patient care, and is always disheveled and smells bad.

Be careful if you go here and end up with this "doc."

Excellent hospital! I took my Siberian Husky, Polar, there because of a stroke that suddenly left him unable to walk… thankfully, thanks to the excellent care of the neurology and rehabilitation team, Polar was able to walk again ❤️ All the staff treated Polar with great care, professionalism, and dedication, and they explained his diagnosis and the next steps for his full recovery to us at all times.

I absolutely do not recommend this place; their priority is to collect as much money as possible. They have good veterinarians, but the administration is completely inhumane. They leave doctors on call who are not well-prepared. In my experience, they kept prolonging my dog's agony just to keep collecting payment until a doctor from the same clinic, but working independently, told us that there was honestly nothing more that could be done. And during the days my dog ​​was hospitalized there, I saw several dogs die, and their owners complained about the poor care.
They are very professional; their experience is evident.

The care is good, but I think they're excessive with keeping your pet hospitalized for so many days, and you're only allowed to see them for 15 minutes a day. Of course, they charge you extra for everything.

EXCELLENT VETERINARY HOSPITAL PEQUES 🐶🙏🏻💖... THANK GOD 🙏🏻🐶💖 THE VET DOCTOR ATTENDED. Alejandro Arceo to Brunito 🐶🙏🏻💖 Excellent, immediate care... He was in an emergency because he was vomiting and had bloody diarrhea 🙏🏻💖🐶😞😔... He was hospitalized for 3 days and is recovering at home with God's blessing 🙏🏻🐶💖... Highly recommended... It's expensive, but it's worth it for the health of this beautiful and very, very loved little one 🐶🙏🏻💖
Dr. Vanessa was very kind and, in general, they were professional in the care of our pets.

Excellent. They treated my dog ​​very well, and the hospitalization, as well as the veterinarians in general, are very good about the dogs.

Highly recommended. I would always trust this veterinary hospital.

We've been going to this veterinary hospital for six months. My dog, Vodka, was diagnosed with an oligodendroglioma. Dr. Miguel Linares (neurologist) and Dr. Gilberto Torres have been monitoring him with chemotherapy and treatment for seizures. The care from them and the clinic is excellent. However, today I went to the hospital for some lab tests that Dr. Gilberto Torres had ordered. When we were seen, we asked the woman who was going to take the samples if she could please take them from the same paw, since it's been six months and the hair hasn't grown back in that area. Dr. Miguel had previously taken samples from the same area to avoid shaving him again. She said she had to take the sample from his neck, but in the end, she didn't even take it from his neck. She hurt him and ended up taking the sample from one of his shaved paws. My dog's case is very complex, so we ask that he be treated with more dignity, as we are going through a very difficult situation. We also ask that the young lady change her attitude towards the dogs and their families, since they are everything to us and their well-being is what matters most to us.
I liked the service and the attention, they answer all the questions on the spot and my kitten is very happy.
Excellent, they helped us lift our dog, everything was very professional. Thank you very much.
Difficult to find parking

We came to get an ultrasound for my dog. We were seen after about 40 minutes (it's understandable that we had to wait). During the examination, the vet asked some questions, and when we asked questions to clarify, they answered almost in monosyllables. I understand that we weren't in a consultation with them, but I also believe that answering questions is part of the service. They made us wait another 40 minutes or so for the interpretation and the ultrasound. We expected them to give us some printed images, which didn't happen; they only gave us a CD. When we asked if they could email us the images, they refused. Honestly, computers don't have CD drives anymore; I don't know how they can continue delivering the reports like this. There's no sense of warmth or interest in the animals. I don't recommend them. I just get the feeling that they see animals as a business.

I found it good and reasonably priced. We've struggled a lot with my Westie because of allergies and stomach problems. Other places just gave her injections. Here, they focused on finding the root cause, and my dog ​​is improving.

Whenever I go, they see us quickly. They do order tests, but they're appropriate for what's needed; in my opinion, they don't overdo it with the tests.
A good hospital has what is needed for accurate diagnoses.

The service is incredibly slow; they make you wait a long time. Once you're seen, they charge you for everything; they order unnecessary tests and don't send the results; they give you the doctors' WhatsApp numbers for follow-up, but they never reply. The medications are very expensive, and the cashier is extremely rude. They make a lot of money off dogs. Don't take your pets there.
So happy this place is open again! They've helped my little one so much that all I can say is thank you. Highly recommended. Definitely the best in the area.

We took my dog ​​to the vet because she was panting. Without even examining her, they wanted to cut her open and put her in surgery.
After seeking a second opinion, I found out she was just stressed.

We took my dog ​​to the emergency vet at night, and without even examining her, they wanted to operate. When we questioned the doctor about why they were operating without an examination, he got indignant and kicked us out of the vet's office 🤬🤯 …

This hospital is absolutely terrible. The doctor didn't even touch my dog ​​to examine her before he wanted to anesthetize her and take her into surgery. When I questioned him about why she wasn't an old dog, he told me to leave. I had heard about this kind of mistreatment before and didn't believe it. Don't go there; to them, your pets are just a fee.

I took my pet there for a checkup and medical care. I think the care is adequate, although the costs are a bit high, but I believe it's worth it if we want our pet to be healthy and live a good life. It's open 24 hours a day; their policy of not selling food or medicine at night is ridiculous, but that's how they operate.
Excellent, we saw a neurologist and were seen very quickly. They have an MRI.

Excellent service, including hospitalization, surgery, and MRI. The professionals are clearly competent and incredibly caring. We had a neurological emergency with our daughter, Frida, who was hospitalized for 15 days. We witnessed firsthand the quality of their emergency care and daily treatment, and we are so happy and grateful for everything they did for her. Dr. Miguel Romero was incredible, always attentive, providing a very clear diagnosis, and always being very honest throughout the process. Overall, he was very clear about what was happening and the possible consequences. The surgery and daily follow-up were also handled by highly capable professionals.

The prices are fair and, above all, the billing process is transparent and clear.
Excellent service and reasonably priced, but very professional.
Excellent care!! They pulled my dog ​​through with an accurate diagnosis, care, and treatment!! We are so grateful!!!
This is without a doubt the best place for anything you need for your pets. They are very professional and truly love their work. I recommend them 100%.

A couple of months ago, I took my 8-year-old boxer in. They told me he had metastatic cancer, and they treated him very well. We were also treated well, and I didn't think the service was expensive. The doctors and interns were attentive, and you could tell they cared about their patients.
Excellent doctors. They are all very kind and professional. The reception staff are always attentive and professional.
Excellent service, the best care for our beloved pets!! ♥️

Dr. Carolina and her team saved my dog's life. He had pneumonia, and they took excellent care of him. Dr. Carolina has a wonderful way with people, and I congratulate her on her dedication and love for animals. The diagnosis and treatment were perfect.

I'm truly glad they were shut down. They killed my pet because they didn't treat her properly in the emergency room. Besides, they're not charismatic at all. They're all incredibly rude. They even charge for a used needle. That's my truth. 🤬🤬🤬🤬 …

Excellent hospital! My dog ​​arrived at Dr. Humberto's (neurology department) and was quickly treated, diagnosed, and medicated for idiopathic epilepsy. They've been with us for six years now. They are professional and keep a perfect record of tests, appointments, medications—everything documented by us. Fair treatment, both personally and financially. The whole team is wonderful ❤️ 10 out of 10 for everyone, especially Dr. Humberto and Dr. Miguel 🙏🏼

The worst thing that could have happened to us was going to this vet clinic.
My dog ​​died there because they never gave her the medication she needed to prevent seizures. They asked for the medicine box back, supposedly so they wouldn't charge us for it. She died three days later because they never gave her the medication. They returned the box to me exactly as I had given it to them. When she died, no one told us anything—not what had happened, how she died, what time it was, absolutely nothing. They just told us to say goodbye quickly and go outside to pay.
Horrible place, never go there.

In response to all the critics: a veterinarian never profits from their work, nor do they go to work thinking about it. You, the owners, most of the time, bring your pets in poor condition, sick for several days, when they no longer eat or drink water, or when they drink much more than their food. If they have a fracture, you don't want to take them to the vet and prefer to treat them yourselves without first knowing if their internal organs are damaged. You don't get timely lab tests, etc. And if the pet dies, you blame the veterinarians, or you end up harming them, killing them, and even destroying their businesses, when the fault lies solely with the owners and not the veterinarians, who have to take care of their families, pay for services and equipment, as well as supplies, and yet you say they profit. Think about this and stop speaking ill of veterinarians.
It was a very good hospital with excellent veterinarians, but look for other options because now that it's closed, they left us without care and my little one died.

They have good service but the prices are excessive when you are in a critical operational situation and in my case they asked for tests that had already been done on my pet without receiving a logical reason for why to do them again.

We arrived for an emergency with our dog and the service was poor; they didn't even attend to him. We had to go to another clinic. They don't know how to differentiate between an emergency and a real emergency.

Excellent service! I'm so grateful to Dr. Liz and Dr. Humberto for always being so attentive to my baby, with such great ethics and such big hearts. Thank you for everything, and I trust that Peques will be open again very soon so we can bring our babies. 🙏 …

The vet is expensive, but they were the only ones who diagnosed my dog ​​Pepe. They were the only ones who told us what he had, and we were able to give him a better quality of life and keep him with us longer. I hope they come back. They had the best ethics, the best follow-up care, and they were respectful when Pepe passed away. And in Pepe's memory, I hope justice is served and they reopen the clinic.

In the emergency room, they forced me to undergo a procedure that didn't help my pet, and he died, with Dr. Morales' approval. They charge you for taking the blood sample, the syringe, the cotton, and the alcohol. Exorbitant prices. Look for better alternatives. The doctors need to stay up-to-date.
I hope the place reopens. It's a shame that such bad people do everything to slander a good hospital.

Excellent service, distinguished by its professionalism and medical care combined with a human touch.
They make you feel supported, listened to, and understood at all times, providing an accurate and honest diagnosis!

My dog ​​was very ill with pain and vomiting. They helped her and saved her. They gave me the option of admitting her or taking her home, being very clear and honest about the risks and care.

Thank you, Peques Veterinary Hospital!

Excellent service and a medical team committed to friendly communication with owners and loving care for pets.
A truly comprehensive clinic with a top-notch team capable of treating any ailment with excellent results.
Congratulations on your dedication!
I went to get my dog ​​tested and it's closed, nobody gives information, they don't answer the phone
Excellent care from the medical staff and top-notch facilities.
Dr. Miguel Linares is a legend 🐾 Goyo and I are so grateful ✌🏻🐶🧔🏻‍♂️ …
I like this place because they always take care of my pets with great love and professionalism. This gives me peace of mind.
Definitely the best hospital in the city, excellent care and great specialists

The best hospital in Mexico City, with the best team of veterinarians and specialists to care for your beloved furry friends. They have extensive medical experience in various fields and provide excellent care to sentient beings. Don't hesitate to take your pet in need of veterinary care; it's the best place for them to find the health and stability they need. 🩵🩵🩵🙏🏻🙏🏻 #PequesVeterinaryHospital 🥰

I don't understand why they closed it down. Five years ago, my dog ​​Megara contracted distemper. Of the four veterinarians I took her to, they were the only ones who gave me the correct diagnosis, and not only that, they literally saved her life. From the receptionist to their neurologist, they treated us with great calm and kindness. The treatment they gave us was complicated, but we followed it to the letter. They even told us that Megara would possibly live with seizures, and to this day, thanks to them, Megara has the best quality of life. I am eternally grateful to this hospital, and even though the costs are high, my little one's life is priceless.
Today I wanted to go because of a problem she's having with her hip, and I found them closed. There are many of us who don't entrust the lives of our pets to them.

They're excellent. I have a lot of confidence in them, and they saved my dog. They've treated my other dogs before, and I've always had a great experience with them. They treat them very well. I highly recommend them.

I absolutely do not recommend this place. My dog ​​was in excruciating neck pain, to the point of screaming and crying whenever he made a wrong move, so he absolutely needed to see a veterinary neurologist. I'm a foreigner, and getting good recommendations is quite difficult when you don't know the area, so I trusted the recommendation of the vet in my neighborhood and went to see Dr. Linares and Morales.

The care was humane and kind—I will acknowledge that. They sent me for an MRI at another clinic (which is also much more expensive if you don't pay in cash) and sent me home with medication that did absolutely nothing for my dog, who continued to scream in pain.

The next day we went back, and the neurologists from the veterinary clinic saw us. They told us he had three herniated discs, one of them recent and very painful because it was pressing on the spinal canal. Both seemed like good professionals, but I felt they didn't consider each case individually. Again, they sent him home with more medication and told me that "time" was the only thing that would cure him, without scheduling any follow-up appointments or check-ups.

I decided to seek a second opinion at Neuropets, and they explained that my dog ​​had fragments of his spinal disc floating in the spinal canal, which required urgent physical therapy or surgery. This was completely different from what I had been told previously. My dog ​​has already had surgery and is recovering very well.

Furthermore, the place is always packed, the wait is incredibly long without air conditioning in this heat, the facilities are quite run-down, and frankly, I think it's appalling to leave a dog in the condition mine was in without follow-up care.

My impression was that you're just another patient, and if you ask questions or are even slightly informed, it bothers them. I wouldn't go back.

Very bad experience, they just took my money and don't give any attention to the dogs in the shelter. I realized this because I arrived at a different time and they don't even give them food or medicine.

I was highly recommended this place, and the service wasn't bad, but I arrived with an emergency. I told them my dog ​​was poisoned with Fenabot. Someone came out to check on her and determined it wasn't an emergency. I waited two hours and they didn't attend to me; I had to leave. I returned the next day with my dog ​​unconscious, and they attended to her quickly as an emergency, but she had to be dying before they determined it was an emergency, and she finally died there.
They treated me with kindness and took good care of my dog. I appreciate the attention of all the staff; the service was excellent. I am truly grateful.
I took a friend's patient for x-rays and they are very well organized, the studies are very well done

The doctors are specialists and well-prepared, and the reception staff is generally very good. The only downside I feel is a lack of organization; you need to be prepared for a long wait and allow plenty of time, as I've waited at least two hours to be seen on several occasions.
Very good service

I took my cat to an emergency vet and they didn't give him the correct diagnosis. They ended up diagnosing something completely different, and I just wasted my money. When I took him to my regular veterinarian, he diagnosed him correctly, treated him properly, and now he's fine. The facilities and staff were all good; the rating is due to the incorrect diagnosis my pet received.
They took a while to attend to my kitten, but once they did, the service was excellent.

Excellent service and care from the staff and doctors. I brought my dog ​​in for epilepsy after he'd already been to four different veterinarians who couldn't solve anything, and here they gave me an accurate diagnosis and a more than adequate treatment for him. Today my dog ​​is much better, and they've always been available to me for any questions I might have.

From the outset, the care was POOR and UNPROFESSIONAL. At no point was the patient's age asked, a basic piece of information in any medical record; the doctor only asked, "What happened to you?"

I explained the clinical signs in detail, including fever, episodes of vomiting, and changes in appetite. Despite this, the doctor's response was, "If he's already better, why did you bring him in?" which demonstrates a worrying lack of clinical judgment. A patient's evaluation is not based solely on an apparent momentary improvement, but on the complete evolution of their condition.

Additionally, I brought radiographic studies performed the previous day at another hospital, precisely because I was seeking a second opinion. The doctor refused to interpret them, arguing that he hadn't ordered them. This stance is unacceptable: the integration of previous studies is an essential part of the clinical analysis, regardless of where they were performed. Refusing to consider medical history because it wasn't generated in his own department reflects an unethical and limited practice.

The situation worsened when I escalated to the supervisor on duty, who displayed the same attitude. Throughout, I perceived a condescending demeanor, as if not being a veterinarian implied complete ignorance. I am a healthcare professional, and I understand that, in any discipline, the medical record includes background information, clinical evolution, and correlation of studies; ignoring these seriously compromises the quality of care.

MY EXPERIENCE WAS DEEPLY DISAPPOINTING. LACK OF INTEREST, LITTLE WILLINGNESS TO CONDUCT CLINICAL ANALYSIS, AND AN UNPROFESSIONAL ATTITUDE. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR SERIOUS VETERINARY CARE BASED ON COMPREHENSIVE CLINICAL CRITERIA.
It's fine for an emergency, I hope they change the attitude of the receptionists

My vet, who is supposed to be the best, sent me here because he said they have an excellent neurologist, Humberto. When they gave me the same diagnosis as my vet, they called in an internist along with Dr. Humberto and the doctor who initially treated us. They didn't know what the drops my vet had prescribed were. According to them, it was urgent to see a cardiologist and an ophthalmologist, but the tumor wasn't important. Later, I obviously went back to my vet because they didn't tell me anything he hadn't already diagnosed. They profit from the love people have for their pets. Obviously, they charge because it's a hospital, but without qualified staff, just to drag things out and increase their profits? Don't go there if you truly love your pets. I took my dog ​​to this veterinary hospital in a genuine medical emergency, expecting professional care, clarity, and a response focused on the animal's well-being. Unfortunately, my experience turned out to be deeply troubling.

My dog ​​was given palliative treatment. However, given the stress and urgency, I never saw the medication or its packaging opened in front of me, nor was I clearly shown what substance was being injected or at what dosage. At that moment, I had to rely solely on the staff's word, without any possibility of direct verification.

I should clarify that I am neither a doctor nor a veterinarian, so it is difficult for me to technically discern what happened or whether the procedure was appropriate from a clinical perspective. However, as a responsible pet owner, I can confirm that in the following hours my dog's condition worsened significantly, experiencing intense and unbearable pain, to the point that he is now on the verge of death. We are about to put him to sleep.

Given this critical situation, I have been forced to seek help at other veterinary hospitals now that it's morning, trying to save his life and understand what happened.

Upon reviewing previous online reviews, a worrying pattern seems to exist: an insistence on ordering multiple tests, promoting hospitalizations, and creating a considerable administrative burden, while transparency regarding the administered medications is not entirely clear. This situation is evident and alarming, especially in emergency situations.

Therefore, I believe it is essential to warn other pet owners:

👉 Explicitly verify what is being injected into your dogs, ask to see the vial, the name of the medication, and the dosage before it is administered.

👉 Don't take anything for granted, even in an environment that presents itself as professional.

I share this review out of anguish and a sense of responsibility, not as an accusation, but as a warning for other owners to demand complete transparency in their pets' medical care. Today, my dog ​​continues to fight for his life, and no one should have to go through such an experience without clear and readily available information.
